book.title: Yeisu Wasane Dodohobine Metiu wana Luluweli

content: Yeisu I Suwoyukim he Mate
Yan Sabat i mwao, he wik hana yan dedei hei henanai suwok, Meri Magdala vainiine bwaine wana valese si la si kenani haliwage.
Habeto mwaniknik lahine i youmate. Guyau wana anelose hotiya i sehudi he bulubulu i la he haliwage, i pulim yok pak ge i tuwodau he pwatane.
Mangingine i piklame sohode pilame ge hana kaliko i kanekane sohode kepwalipwali.
Tosasagiyao hebwaden si mimitahasik haliwage si matok suwok ge si ginu, bwen si sopiyele he kelekele, taine si denipinipi, sidiye sohode tomate.
Anelose i liwo venakau yake heidiye i nga, “Tab hu ematok! A lapu Yeisu gane si tagakoros-yan hu luluweni.
Agegene tan i degan te he ya, hobak i suwoyuk, sohode wana lihu. Hu luwom hu paidi habane, gane i hinhiyene hei.
Habekik hu lok ge hu la hu giyau wana topadavae wedi wase hu nga, ‘Hobak i suwoyuk he mate ge bwele i dedei he matamiu i la Galili. Habe hu paidi hei.’ Lemi wase te hobak a giyau tei.”
Bwen venakau yake habekik si seyok haliwage, si matok, agegene yariyae hedi i susuwoku he hatiyediye, ge si patadei si ela tage si egiyau wana topadavae wedi wase.
Sauge si edodogan la he hiyede, habe Yeisu i sepaleid ge i nga, “A gomulolu heimiu!” Si luwom heine si lipwakoko, hehene si pihasik ge si kululu heine.
Habeto Yeisu i liwo heidiye i nga, “Tab matok! Hu la hu giyau he-hauhavau wedi wase gen si la Galili, habe bwele si paidiyau te he yake.”
Haliwage hana Tomatahasik wedi Wase

Saugeine venakau si edodogan la he hiyede, bwen tosasagiyao topadine hebwaden haliwage hana tomatahasik si sehavile si la Jerusalem, ge bigi bwabwaligane gane i youmate si waseyan topowo lalahine heidiye.
Habeto topowo lalahine he-bwaidiye Judiya wedi todedei si mipase ge si ginawi wedi logugui hotiya, bwen si giyau mwani lahine tosasagiyao heidiye.
Si liwo heidiye si nga, “Hu liwo bobode heidiye hu nga, ‘Ha hene saole he gogou, hoge wana topadavae si luwom ge si howo tuwane.’
Hebe Pilato i longe wase ya, hamai habe bwele ha gopasapu heine, iyete taine bwele hu depaidi ngakine hotiya.”
Bwen tosasagiyao si howo mwani ge si ginawi sohode topowo lalahine wedi lihulihu heidiye. Iyete Judiya bobodeidiye si pareru wase yake hana had yan ya, tage Yeisu wana topadavae si la si howo tuwane.
Yeisu I Patileid Topadavae Si Waseyan Hidane
Topadavae hebwaden si he-yawate si he-tiya (11) si la Galili, he bobokun gane veto Yeisu i lihuyan heidiye.
Saugeine si paidi, bwen si kululu heine, agegene topadine si nuwo veveiwo.
Yeisu i pililok heidiye bwen i nga, “Logugui ge gaisi bwabwaligane he bulubulu ge he panayawi, hobak Tamau i giyau heyau.
Iyete hu la hu wase wabene bwabwaligane heidiye gen si tabwa lo topadavae, hu pabaptaisid Tamade, Natune ge Yayaluwo Gagabubine he hidane heine,
ge logugui bwabwaligane gane a lihuyan heimiu hu palapuid gen si sebelen. Tolosuwok nau bwele bwaimiu ege sauge bwabwaligane hana had panayawi hana bagapamwao.”
